race.comment: MALAMAGIC (5) didn't have the cleanest of debuts but still showed plenty of promise finishing second to Dragon Link, who has since come out and won well again. Is sure to have come on from the experience and should be blending in at the right time. Can get the job done this time.STAR ROUGE (9) returns from five weeks between runs after finishing fifth at this track on debut, beaten just over a length. That form reads well enough for a maiden of this shape. OVERABUNDANT (7) was beaten just under a length as favourite on debut at Eagle Farm after being bumped at the start, so he has genuine upside if he handles the extra ground. Debutant ZOUCOUP (12) is a Zoustar colt on debut for the Kendrick partnership. Showed enough in his trial win and gets the key booking of Thompson from the inside pillar. Can make a bright start.
